REPORT DATE: 06-02-2021 REPORT TIME: 0100 UTC REGION: GULF OF MEXICO SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: MISSISSIPPI CANYON 20 IMAGE DATE: 06-01-2021 IMAGE TIME: 1628 UTC DATA SOURCE: SENTINEL2B MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 10 METER LOCATION: 28°56"16" N/88°58"14" W AREA: 0.38 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: HIGH REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THE ANOMALY MEASURED APPROXIMATELY 2.8 NMI IN LENGTH AND UP TO 0.08 NMI IN WIDTH. IT HAD A BARELY-VISIBLE BUT DISTINCT APPEARANCE AGAINST ITS BACKGROUND, EXCEPT FOR THE PORTION OF THE ANOMALY NEAREST THE SUSPECTED SOURCE, WHICH HAD A MILKY-WHITE APPEARANCE SUGGESTING THICKER OIL. WINDS AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE FROM THE ESE AT AROUND 10 KTS. NRC REPORT #1306553 INDICATED AN OBSERVED OIL SLICK AT THIS LOCATION 30 MINUTES PRIOR TO THE IMAGE TIME. THE REPEAT LEAK NATURE OF THE SUSPECTED SOURCE AND THE NRC REPORT ALLOW FOR HIGH CONFIDENCE THAT THIS WAS OIL. UNCERTAINTIES: THE ANOMALY WAS PARTIALLY OBSCURED BY CLOUDS IN THE REGION. properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 811035 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party:
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 811035
Incident Time: 2006-08-20 15:00:00
Nearest City: Simi Valley, CA
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: UNKNOWN POISON
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
CALLER STATES AN UNKNOWN POISON DISCHARGED FROM A POWER LINE INTO HER SWIMMING POOL, AND IS AFFECTING THE SWIMMING WATER AND RESIDENTS ANIMALS. THE POWER LINE HAD INITIALLY BEEN CHEWED THROUGH BY A SQUIRREL, AND HAD POISON APPLIED TO THE AFFECTED AREA. IT WAS REPAIRED, AND RE-HUNG AS USUAL. THE CURRENT INCIDENT INVOLVES THE EXACT SEGMENT OF POWER LINE WHICH INITIALLY WAS INVOLVED IN THE SQUIRREL INCIDENT. CALLER STATES WHEN THE LINE WAS RE-STRUNG AFTER THE SQUIRREL INCIDENT, IT WAS HUNG TOO LOW, CAUSING A VEHICLE TO STRIKE IT DOWN AND INTO HER SWIMMING POOL. CALLER WAS TOLD BY CABLE COMPANY THAT THEY COULD NOT DRAIN THE POOL AS IT NOW CONTAINS POISONOUS MATERIALS FOR WHICH THEY ARE NOT RESPONSIBLE, BUT THAT THE OWNER MUST IMMEDIATELY DRAIN THE POOL AND SCRUB IT DOWN THOROUGHLY. THE CABLE LINE HAS SINCE BEEN RAISED 5 FEET BY THE COMPANY, BUT NOTHING HAS BEEN DONE TO REMEDY POISON CONTAINED IN POOL. CALLER'S DOG HAD INITIALLY BEEN COUGHING UP BLOOD SHORTLY AFTER THE INCIDENT, AND A RESIDENT ANIMAL IS ALSO AILING, POSSIBLY DUE TO THIS UNKNOWN MATERIAL. CALLER WOULD LIKE SOMEONE TO COME OUT AND TEST THE WATER, WHICH HAS SINCE TURNED DARK BLACK, WITH PATCHES OF GREEN MOSSY MATERIAL.

Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** F-15 WAS AT 15 MILE FINAL WHEN HE HAD AN UNCOMMANDED FUEL VENTING EMERGENCY. HE CONTACTED SOF AT 10 MILE FINAL WITH HIS FUEL STATE (9000#) AND WAS INFORMED TO FLY HIS JET FIRST, AND LAND SAFELY. HE LANDED WITHOUT INCIDENT AND CLEARED OFF AT TAXIWAY G WHERE HE WAS MET BY JFRD FIRST, FOLLOWED BY 125TH FW FIRE DEPARTMENT ASSETS QUICKLY AFTER. ONCE CLEAR OF THE RUNWAY, HE RAN THE CHECKLIST OVER THE RADIO WITH THE SOF AND MANAGED TO STOP THE VENTING. SOF INSTRUCTED THE FIRE CHIEF TO CHECK FOR HOT BRAKES AND TO PLAN ON SHUTTING DOWN ONCE PINNED UP. FIRE RESCUE ASSETS SAFELY PINNED AND SHUT A/C 146 DOWN ON TAXIWAY G. ESTIMATE THAT APPROX 500# OF JP8 WAS VENTED ONTO RUNWAY 08 AND TAXIWAY G DURING THE EVENT.

THE ANOMALY APPEARED TO WIDEN WITH DISTANCE TO THE NORTH, WAS DARK AGAINST ITS BACKGROUND, AND WAS VISUALLY DISTINCT AND DISTANT FROM KNOWN NATURAL SEEPS LOCATED IN OTHER AREAS OF THE IMAGE. UNCERTAINTIES: THE POINT SOURCE WAS IDENTIFIED BASED ON THE PRESENCE OF A PIPELINE AT THE NARROW END OF THE ANOMALY, ALONG WITH THE WIND DIRECTION SUPPORTING THIS AS THE ORIGIN END. HOWEVER, NO KNOWN REPORTS OF AN OIL SHEEN OR LEAK WERE FOUND. THE ANOMALY EDGES WERE ALSO SOMEWHAT ILL-DEFINED, RAISING THE POSSIBILITY THAT THIS WAS EITHER A SEEP OR NOT OIL.
